nav.offline: Offline. Anything that needs the internet is paused; the rest still works.

state.storageUnsupported: This browser cannot store the page's data, so nothing from this session will be kept once the tab closes. Open it in a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari and it will be saved.
state.storageBlocked: This window will not let the page store data, so nothing from this session will be kept once the tab closes. Open it in a normal window rather than a private one and it will be saved.
state.storageOtherTab: Breadcrumb is already open in another tab, and nothing here will be saved. Go back to that tab to carry on, or close it and reload this page.
